entries.t: <FACE:69>Heh heh… you show more<NL>promise than my men!<WAIT>Well then… join my<NL>Space Robo Robo Gang?<WAIT>I'll treat you well

<FACE:01>Now you say that?!<NL><WAIT>You stole the Cluster<NL>and dragged it here<WAIT>Think we'd listen to<NL>crooks like you?<WAIT><FACE:00>One more thing I want<NL>to ask you<WAIT>You bring the Cluster<NL>here… for what?
<FACE:69>I'm Professor Kazanbai<NL>I lead the Sperobos!<WAIT>A sister society to<NL>Earth's Rubberobos!<WAIT>We have pushed out<NL>into outer space<WAIT>to conquer and rule<NL>this vast universe!

<FACE:69>Looking back, it was<NL>nothing but hardship…<WAIT>We aimed for Mars and<NL>snuck aboard a probe<WAIT>But the weight of us<NL>riding it<WAIT>threw it off course<NL>and it hit this rock<WAIT>We hurried and built<NL>this base from it!
<FACE:12>Unbelievable…<NL>Impossible…
<FACE:6A>My dictionary has no<NL>word 'impossible'!
<FACE:0E>A misprint?
<FACE:0F>Heh, probably means he<NL>knows it by heart
<FACE:6A>Gwaaaaah!<NL><WAIT>You lot! Don't you<NL>know Napoleon's line?
<FACE:11>I know, I was just<NL>joking<WAIT><FACE:0F>Anyway, no probe makes<NL>a base like this…
<FACE:6A>It can't be done, eh?!<NL><WAIT>Yet here I am, alive<NL>and well!<WAIT>If I'd given up I<NL>wouldn't be here!
<FACE:69>It's all a matter of<NL>the will to survive
<FACE:6A>BUUUT!<NL><WAIT>Humans haven't gone<NL>past Earth's orbit!<WAIT><FACE:69>With nobody to attack<NL>there's nothing to do<WAIT>So a dreary life in<NL>the hideout went on…
<FACE:06>Are you kind of dumb?<NL><WAIT>Going out into space<NL>with nobody to rule!
<FACE:02>Easy, Hiyori<NL>let's hear him out
<FACE:06>Do you even know<NL>what's going on here…
<FACE:6A>QUIEEEET!!<NL><WAIT>I didn't act without<NL>thinking either!<WAIT>I found a real fix,<NL>and this plan is it!
<FACE:69>Take a space station<NL>like the Cluster<WAIT>and haul it out to the<NL>asteroid belt. Then…
<FACE:69>Tourists will flock to<NL>the new attraction
<FACE:69>Asteroid cruises and<NL>asteroid cakes sell!
<FACE:69>And space development<NL>speeds right up!
<FACE:00>…So you stole the<NL>Cluster for tourists?
<FACE:69>Indeed!<NL><WAIT>And it lays the base<NL>for mankind in space
<FACE:03>Wow, he really thought<NL>it through
<FACE:06>Hey, you!<NL><WAIT>Are you buying this?!
<FACE:01>No, that's one thing<NL>and this is another!<WAIT>Professor!
<FACE:01>Give us back control<NL>of the Cluster!<WAIT>We want to go home<WAIT><FACE:6A>That I cannot do!<NL><WAIT>As future Sperobo Gang<NL>members, you lot<WAIT>will be staying here!
<FACE:69>You alone truly heard<NL>my dream<WAIT>aside from my own men<WAIT>What's left in the<NL>Cluster's tank is low<WAIT>Take some fuel as a<NL>parting gift
<FACE:02>Thanks, Professor!
<FACE:00>All right, everyone<NL>let's head back!
<FACE:02>Ah, Niwaka!<NL><WAIT>The Cluster's safe, so<NL>you worked hard too!
<FACE:22>Not at all…<NL>It was Navi's help<WAIT>On my own I could<NL>never have done it…
<FACE:08>(Niwaka's gotten<NL>awfully honest!?)
<FACE:0F>Fire up the boosters<NL>and set course home
<FACE:0F>Navi, run the orbit<NL>calculation<WAIT><FACE:53>Roger. Calculating…<NL>…please wait 10 min…
<FACE:22><PLAYER>… everyone…<NL>…I've been wrong…<WAIT><FACE:00>It's fine now, Niwaka<NL>But you've changed?<WAIT><FACE:22>Ah, that too is all<NL>thanks to Navi…
<FACE:25>Aaah!
<FACE:03>Navi! What's wrong?<NL>The calculation…?

<FACE:53>It is not me!<NL><DELAY:003C><DELAY:0007><CLEAR>A vast flood of data<NL>from the Lobby Block…<DELAY:0078><DELAY:0018><CLEAR>The Cluster is out of<NL>my control now!!<DELAY:003C><DELAY:0028><END>
<FACE:08>What's going on?<NL>A hacker, maybe?
<FACE:12>Impossible!<NL>The Lobby Block?<WAIT>There's no computer<NL>that powerful there…
<FACE:08>Look! It's Mistral!<WAIT><FACE:12>That… is that Mistral?<WAIT><FACE:08>It's getting bigger!
<FACE:10>Seems that Medabot is<NL>running the Cluster…
<FACE:04>Mistral… where are you<NL>trying to take us?
<FACE:04>…It's dangerous here…
<FACE:09>What's wrong, <PLAYER>…

<FACE:01>It's dangerous here!<NL>Let's go back to the<WAIT>control room, farthest<NL>away! Get everyone!<WAIT><FACE:10>Right, this thing is<NL>digging into the net<WAIT>Cut the cables and<NL>protect Navi too!
<FACE:0F>That does it… Phew<NL>No more break-ins now
<FACE:08>Look!<NL><WAIT>That<DELAY:0014>… is that Jupiter?
<FACE:12>Impossible!<NL><WAIT>When did it speed up<NL>that much?!
<FACE:14>Aaah!<NL><WAIT>That… uh…<NL>what was it called…<WAIT>You know, that red<NL>dot on Jupiter?<WAIT><FACE:0A>The Great Red Spot…
<FACE:16>Yes, that's the one!<NL><WAIT>That's our leader!<NL>I underrated you!<WAIT><FACE:14>And something's coming<NL>out of that Red Spot!
<FACE:0D>Ah, you're right
<FACE:03>What a huge spaceship…
<FACE:0F>Isn't that Mistral's<NL>mother ship?
<FACE:05>Could it be…<NL>here to get Mistral?
<FACE:03>It's getting closer<NL>and closer!
<FACE:08>Oh no!<NL><WAIT>Mistral just vanished!
<FACE:08>Are they going to grab<NL>the whole Cluster?
<FACE:12>It's possible!<NL><WAIT>A ship that size could<NL>swallow the Cluster!
<FACE:10>It's no use…
<FACE:10>Control's been taken<NL>from us completely!
<FACE:04>Did we get caught?
<FACE:13>It's dark outside so I<NL>can't see, but…<WAIT>Sensors and radar are<NL>all dead…<WAIT>Seems we're completely<NL>shut in…
<FACE:6A>…Losing to middle<NL>schoolers, of all!
<FACE:69>It seems…<NL>a new age has begun…<WAIT>I got full of myself<NL>for reaching space<WAIT>Then aimlessly I shut<NL>myself in the hideout<WAIT>All that moaning made<NL>me weak at Robattles…
<FACE:69>A fresh start, then…
<FACE:69>…Very well!<NL>Go home if you wish!
<FACE:69>The arm is released<NL>Back to the Cluster!<WAIT><FACE:00>Professor…
<FACE:69>Ah, right!<NL><WAIT>I'll share some fuel
